methodology.routeSource: Gatsby page-data/ manifest (34 directories under page-data/, incl. 9 under page-data/blog/) cross-checked against every <route>/index.html on disk and a live crawl of the rendered homepage's nav + footer links; every route confirmed HTTP 200 from `node serve.js 8080` before measurement.
perPageSteps: programmatic lazy-scroll in 400px steps to the full document height + 2000px buffer, to trigger lazy-loaded imagery and any scroll-driven animation classes

page.evaluate: tally every visible text node's computed font-family/size/weight/line-height/letter-spacing/color; every visible element's background-color/border-radius/box-shadow/border/gap/padding/max-width/aspect-ratio/grid-template-columns; walk <header> + <main>'s direct children (validated against raw HTML structure — this build wraps the whole page in single-child div chains down to #___gatsby, so 'nearest content landmark' rather than 'first branching div' is what finds real sections) to record the section sequence; collect every element with a non-zero transition/animation plus every CSSOM @keyframes rule plus every position:sticky/fixed element.
